name: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
definition: Compression neuropathy of the median nerve within the carpal tunnel at the wrist.

typical: Numbness or tingling in the median-nerve hand distribution

redFlags.item: Rapidly progressive weakness or thenar wasting
Proximal neurological signs suggesting cervical cord/root disease

investigations.principle: Diagnosis may be clinical in typical cases; testing is selected by severity and uncertainty.
investigations.radiographs: Electrodiagnostic testing is useful when diagnosis is uncertain, severe/atypical or before some surgical decisions; ultrasound may support diagnosis.

amber: Local corticosteroid injection and carpal tunnel release require individualized severity and risk assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Peripheral Vata/neuropathy phenotype may be documented; median neuropathy at the wrist remains the modern diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Compression neuropathy of the median nerve within the carpal tunnel at the wrist.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Clinical Practice Guideline on Management of Carpal Tunnel Syndrome — 2024
